type.description: The type id of the request

snippets.description: Config snippets by the extension point of the main template they fill

template.description: A custom main config template, the built-in one when empty

mode.description: The TLS verification mode, server for one-way TLS or mutual to require a client cert, mutual when empty

sans.description: Subject Alternative Names for the server cert, IPs become IP SANs and anything else a DNS name, localhost, 127.0.0.1 and ::1 when empty

handshake_first.description: Performs the TLS handshake before the server sends INFO, clients must dial handshake first

timeout.description: The TLS handshake timeout in seconds, fractions honored, 2 seconds when zero

tls.description: Generated TLS on the client port, none when absent

trace.description: Fronts the server with a capture proxy that stores every connection's trace, implies proxy

proxy.description: Fronts the server with a capture proxy that stores no captures

toxics.description: Fronts the server's client listener with a proxy of the agent so toxics can act on it
